basic_info.description: Calling all developers and contractors.  Home has great bones with potential to remodel or start from scratch.  Could be a tremendous opportunity to live in and slowly redo. Wood burning fireplace with 3 bedrooms 2 baths.  Living area is on a single level with light filled living room & dining room.  Attached spacious garage with high ceilings, laundry area and storage. Entry has a security door with buzzer and then a walk-up from the street.  Close to restaurants, shops, parks and an ten minute walk to Bart. Enjoy urban convenience with suburban tranquility. Make Laidley Street and Glen Park your new home. Floor plans show larger living square footage, but buyer to investigate for themselves. Fenced backyard    PROBATE SALE
